_note: SPEC-95 unlock seed/override — the documented FALLBACK for tokens the public auto feed (DefiLlama emissions) doesn't track yet (brand-new names like Audiera). Keyed off cg_id (req #6 token-identity discipline). Each entry: {cg_id, ticker, date (YYYY-MM-DD), amount (token units), type unlock|cliff|tge|vesting, source, detail}. The `unlocks` capability SIZES these off the CANONICAL CoinGecko circulating supply + live price (never a single-chain GoPlus total_supply). Populate from a public unlock tracker (Tokenomist/CryptoRank web) when the auto feed has no coverage; remove once DefiLlama picks the token up.
